newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda sees group operating profit of 356 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Honda sees group operating profit of 356 bln yen.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd expects group operating profits to hit 356 billion yen in the current fiscal year which ends March 1997, Satoshi Aoki, the director in charge of Honda's finance department, told Reuters on Friday.
Honda's actual group operating profit in 1995/96 was 143.6 billion yen, he said.
Honda revised up its domestic sales target to 760,000 vehicles for the full year from an August forecast of 750,000.
It also revised up its export forecast to 410,000 vehicles from a prediction of 380,000 in August.
Honda also raised its domestic vehicle production forecast to 1.14 million vehicles for the full year from an August forecast of 1.10 million.
